text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Negeri Sabah (Peluasan dan

Ubah Suaian Akta Peniaga Sekendhend 1946) 2011.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 12 Julai 2011.

Peluasan dan ubah suaian Akta ke Negeri Sabah

2. (1) Akta Peniaga Sekendhend 1946 [Akta 189], yang disebut "Akta yang

dipeluaskan" dalam Perintah ini, adalah dipeluaskan ke Negeri Sabah.

(2) Dalam pemakaiannya bagi Negeri Sabah, Akta yang dipeluaskan diubah

suai sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

NEGERI SABAH

[Subperenggan 2(2)]

Sekendhend 1946

diperuntukkan selainnya

secara nyata kemudian

daripada ini)

Sebutan mengenai "Chief Police Officer"

hendaklah ditafsirkan sebagai sebutan

mengenai "Commissioner of Police".

"only in Peninsular Malaysia" dengan

MALAYSIA ACT

STATE OF SABAH (EXTENSION AND MODIFICATION OF THE

SECOND-HAND DEALERS ACT 1946) ORDER 2011

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 74 of the Malaysia Act [Act 26/1963], the

Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the State of Sabah (Extension and

Modification of the Second-hand Dealers Act 1946) Order 2011.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 12 July 2011.

Extension and modification of the Act to the State of Sabah

2. (1) The Second-hand Dealers Act 1946 [Act 189], which is referred to as the

"extended Act" in this Order, is extended to the State of Sabah.

(2) In its application to the State of Sabah, the extended Act is modified in the

manner set out in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

THE STATE OF SABAH

[Subparagraph 2(2)]

Provisions of the

Second-hand Dealers Act 1946

Modification

The whole (except where

it is expressly otherwise

provided hereinafter)

References to "Chief Police Officer" shall

be construed as references to

"Commissioner of Police".

Section 1 In subsection (2), substitute for the words

"only in Peninsular Malaysia" the words

"to Peninsular Malaysia and the State of

Sabah".

Section 7 In subsection (2), substitute for the words

", Chinese and Tamil languages" the words

"and Chinese languages".

Made 23 June 2011

[KDN(S)/9/836 Klt.4(67); PN(PU2)112/IV]

By Command,

TAN SRI MOHD. SIDEK BIN HAJI HASSAN

Secretary to the Cabinet

[To be laid before Dewan Rakyat and Dewan Negara pursuant to subsection 74(9) of the

Malaysia Act]
